dressupdoc_balletflat1.author: DressUpDoc
dressupdoc_balletflat1.description: These are low poly gray ballet flat shoes for female toons. The heels poke out a bit on the oldest or heaviest weight or male toons. The toes can poke out a bit on male toons. They have been tested in Unity for mobile games.

dressupdoc_domsjeans1.author: DressUpDoc
dressupdoc_domsjeans1.description: These shoes are low poly jean cloth shoes for female toons. They are similar in style to a popular shoe that rhymes with 'doms'. They have been tested in Unity for mobile games. The heels poke out a bit for oldest heaviest weight and male toons. They aren't as shiny in Blender as they look in the thumbnail.

dressupdoc_maryjane1.author: DressUpDoc
dressupdoc_maryjane1.description: These shoes are low poly flat black Mary Jane style shoes for female toons. They have been tested in Unity for mobile games. The heels poke out a bit for male older and heavier weight toons.

dressupdoc_sandals1.author: DressUpDoc
dressupdoc_sandals1.description: These shoes are low poly strappy flat sandals for female toons. The straps are gray black and white and go around ankles mid foot and toes. They have been tested in Unity for mobile games.

elvs_basic_felt_elf_shoes.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_basic_felt_elf_shoes.description: Xmas stylized elf shoes for your makehuman models. Costume shoes.

elvs_caesar_sandals1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_caesar_sandals1.description: A pair of sandals for makehuman female models in dramatic fashion knee height with flat foot. Tri mesh but loads in mh the same. One texture included.

elvs_flatshoe_bow1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_flatshoe_bow1.description: A pair of flat dress shoes for female makehuman models. Tri mesh but loads the same in makehuman . One texture included. This shoe is the bow laden version of a set of decorative shoes.

elvs_flatshoe_gemmed1.description: A pair of flat dress shoes for female makehuman models. Tri mesh but loads the same in makehuman . One texture included. This shoe is the gem encrusted version of a set of decorative shoes.

elvs_flatshoe_plain1.description: A pair of flat dress shoes for female makehuman models. Tri mesh but loads the same in makehuman . One texture included. This shoe is the basis of a set of decorative shoes in a set this being the unadorned version.

elvs_zombie_killer_sneakers.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_zombie_killer_sneakers.description: Request-A pair of sneakers for makehuman female models for the zombie killer character. Tri mesh. One texture setup included.

mindfront_shoes_monk_strap_female.author: Mindfront
mindfront_shoes_monk_strap_female.description: Tags: Shoes Female Elegant. I tried to make the shoes unisex with 'Base Mesh With Helpers' but it was impossible to get them to work in both directions so I made two versions this is done with 'Average Female With Helpers'. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles.

mindfront_shoes_oxford_female.author: Mindfront
mindfront_shoes_oxford_female.description: Tags: Shoes Female Elegant. Cheap shoes model Oxford or circus clown . Something of a rush job I did a while ago when I needed shoes for my scene 'It Begins' thereof are neither mesh and the texturing especially carefully made. The UV mapping could have been better. It was impossible to get them to work as unisex exported with the 'Base mesh with the Helpers' so I made two versions. This version is exported with 'Average Female With Helpers'. The specular map texture is in this case adapted to Blender Internal. The preview is rendered in Blender Cycles.

punkduck_comfortable_sneakers.author: punkduck
punkduck_comfortable_sneakers.description: These sneakers are made for female characters who need healthy shoes instead of high heels. No delete-groups used because of transparency.

punkduck_cycling_shoes.author: punkduck
punkduck_cycling_shoes.description: A typical pair of cycling shoes which are also used in triathlon. The sole is made on a special rigid group so it cannot bend like in reality . This is done because of the adaptors of the pedal system should not distort. Delete groups are used.

punkduck_kill_bill_shoes.author: punkduck
punkduck_kill_bill_shoes.description: A pair of shoes used in martial arts derived from my running-shoes with a thinner sole. These shoes are made for the Beatrix Kiddo character Kill Bill . Delete groups are used. The texture is made manually to make the shoes look like the ones in the movie. A normalmap is supplied and made visible with the leather litsphere.

punkduck_running_shoes_01.author: punkduck
punkduck_running_shoes_01.description: Typical light-weight running shoes used for long-distance running and triathlon. Delete groups are used.

punkduck_tennis_shoes.author: punkduck
punkduck_tennis_shoes.description: These shoes are derived from my running shoes. I combined the shoes with socks. Delete groups are used. A litsphere is used to make the normal map visible in Makehuman.
